d:
Shri hanumanashtak aadity garhvi ke bhavyukt svar men. sankatmochan hanumanashtak ki sanrachna gosvami tulsidas ne ki thi. mana jata hai ki sankatmochan hanumanashtak ka path karne se vyakti apni har badha aur pira se mukt ho jata hai aur uske sabhi sankat dur ho jate hain.
Watch the video song of "Garud Ka Nahi Tuta Abhiman" now!
Jab garur raj shri ram ko nagpash se mukt karne ki bat se ghamand men chur ho kar narad ji ke pas jate hain. to unhen narad ji ke samjhate hain lekin unke samjhane ke bavjud unka ghamand nahin tutta aur vo bhagvan shiv se milne ke lie chal parte hain.
